SELECT c_customer_id,
       c_salutation,
       c_first_name,
       c_last_name,
       ca_street_number,
       ca_street_name,
       ca_street_type,
       ca_suite_number,
       ca_city,
       ca_county,
       ca_state,
       ca_zip,
       ca_country,
       ca_gmt_offset,
       ca_location_type,
       SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM customer
  JOIN customer_address ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk
  JOIN catalog_returns ON customer.c_customer_sk = catalog_returns.cr_returning_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON catalog_returns.cr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
 WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
   AND customer_address.ca_state = 'TN'
   AND customer_address.ca_address_sk = catalog_returns.cr_returning_addr_sk
 GROUP BY customer.c_customer_sk, customer_address.ca_address_sk, customer_address.ca_state
HAVING SUM(catalog_returns.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) > (
    SELECT AVG(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) * 1.2
      FROM catalog_returns
      JOIN date_dim ON catalog_returns.cr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
     WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
       AND customer_address.ca_state = 'TN'
       AND customer_address.ca_address_sk = catalog_returns.cr_returning_addr_sk
    GROUP BY customer_address.ca_state
    ) 
ORDER BY c_customer_id,
         c_salutation,
         c_first_name,
         c_last_name,
         ca_street_number,
         ca_street_name,
         ca_street_type,
         ca_suite_number,
         ca_city,
         ca_county,
         ca_state,
         ca_zip,
         ca_country,
         ca_gmt_offset,
         ca_location_type,
         SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax)
 LIMIT 100
